question: A solid wooden cuboid of dimensions 60 cm × 45 cm × 30 cm is cut completely into smaller cubes of side 5 cm each. Find the number of smaller cubes formed.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Number of cubes = (60 ÷ 5) × (45 ÷ 5) × (30 ÷ 5)

= 12 × 9 × 6

= 108 × 6

= 648

**∴ Answer = 648**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Dimensions of cuboid = 60 cm, 45 cm, 30 cm; Side of cube = 5 cm

**Formula used:**

Number of cubes = (Length ÷ side) × (Breadth ÷ side) × (Height ÷ side)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Along length = 60 ÷ 5 = 12

⇒ Along breadth = 45 ÷ 5 = 9

⇒ Along height = 30 ÷ 5 = 6

⇒ Total cubes = 12 × 9 × 6

⇒ = 648

**∴ The correct answer is 648.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Relation

Number of cubes = Volume of cuboid ÷ Volume of one cube

Dimension Division

Divide each dimension by cube side to get count along each axis

Alternative Formula

(l × b × h) ÷ a³

Concept Use

Used in cutting blocks into equal smaller cubes
